# Interferon response clean variant 2

Antiviral gene induction was confirmed in PBMCs after IFN-alpha stimulation. IFI6 was upregulated (Table 1). ISG15 was upregulated (Table 1). OAS1 was upregulated (Table 1). IFI44 was upregulated (Table 1). STAT1 was upregulated (Table 1). TNF was downregulated (Table 1). IL6 was downregulated (Table 1).
